name: Multiply the rewards of a round
description: A page at least as large as the widest manifest a game ships: a long description, presets, sliders with long names and descriptions, typed values past the sliders' top behind a switch. It multiplies what a won round gives: the experience, the second kind of experience and the money. The sliders go up to 5x; to go up to 10x, switch on Type values and type them in. Works with the other mods that share the rewards out.

options.name: Experience (x)
options.description: The experience from a round, after the game splits it among the fighters (an equipped bonus item adds its fifth on top).

options.name: Evolution experience (x)
options.description: The second kind of experience, after the game's cap (10 a round, 50 past a threshold).

options.name: Money (x)
options.description: The money from a round (an equipped bonus item's fifth included). It stops at 9,999,999.

options.name: Type values (up to 10x)
options.description: Off: sliders from 1x to 5x (a higher value in the settings counts as 5x). On: type any value from 1x to 10x.

options.name: Rounds between bonuses
options.description: How many rounds go by before the next one gives the bonus.

options.name: What a bonus round gives
options.description: The reward a bonus round multiplies.

options.name: Switch on and off
options.description: A key or a button that switches the multipliers on and off while playing.
